title: 1. The Label
name: The Label
t3: Nobody wants to be the person who “tests it.”
formula: LOW OFFER + A LABEL + SILENCE = THEY UPGRADE
def: Offer the smaller package, imply they can’t commit, then go quiet.

title: 2. The Permission Slip
name: The Permission Slip
touch: When they stall at the end.
t3: Defensive first, then they sell themselves back in.
formula: OFFER THE EXIT → THEY FIGHT FOR STAYING
def: Offer to let them walk away, then remind them why they can’t.

title: 3. The Co-Signer
name: The Co-Signer
touch: “I have to talk to my wife.”
t3: It makes them think, and they move themselves forward.
def: Make them prove they can make the call on their own.

title: 4. The Competitor
name: The Competitor
t3: A mental reframe they’ve never heard on a sales call.
def: Turn walking away into a favor for their rival.

title: 5. The Example
name: The Example
t3: Just nasty. Use it and they won’t forget it.
formula: YOU SAID YES TO EVERYTHING. SO WHY NOT?
def: Make their indecision a lesson their kids are watching.

title: 6. Best for Last
name: The Follow
t3: The cheapest yes you’ll make today.
